% !tp-example Basic usage
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpFillBlank{
  The capital of France is \wcTpTextfield*[name=capital,placeholder=City name,aria-label=Capital of France,clearable]{}.

}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Javascript API
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcScript[type=module]|
import "/components/fill-blank/fill-blank.js";
import "/components/textfield/textfield.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-fill-blank");
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n  "));

const element2 = document.createElement("p");
element2.append(document.createTextNode("The capital of France is "));

const element3 = document.createElement("tp-textfield");
element3.setAttribute("name", "capital");
element3.setAttribute("placeholder", "City name");
element3.setAttribute("aria-label", "Capital of France");
element3.setAttribute("clearable", "");
element2.append(element3);
element2.append(document.createTextNode("."));
element1.append(element2);
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n"));
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
|
\end{document}

% !tp-example Selected answer with tp-blank
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpBox[id=selected-answer-demo]{
  Select a shape or drag it onto the blank. Use its clear button to remove the answer.

  \wcTpFillBlank{
    A shape with three sides is \wcTpBlank*[closed,name=shape,aria-label=Shape with three sides]{}.

  }
  \wcTpButtonGroup[aria-label=Shape choices]{
    \wcTpButton[data-answer=triangle,aria-label=Triangle]{
      \wcImg*[src=/docs/medias/examples/36c2ceb2a29fc3ae.svg,alt=Triangle,width=48,height=40]{}
    }
    \wcTpButton[data-answer=square,aria-label=Square]{
      \wcImg*[src=/docs/components/fill-blank/examples/square.svg,alt=Square,width=48,height=40]{}
    }
  }
  \rawhtml|<tp-dragdrop root="#selected-answer-demo" items="tp-button[data-answer], tp-blank"></tp-dragdrop>|
  The latest event is shown below. FormData is displayed as a list of name/value pairs.

  \wcTpCallout[variant=neutral,heading=tp-fill-blank-change,aria-live=polite,aria-atomic=true]{
    \wcDiv[data-event-output]{No change event yet.}
  }
}

\wcScript[src=/docs/components/fill-blank/examples/selected-answer.js]||
\end{document}
